causes.what: Hypervisor hv-02 is saturated (CPU 96-99%, CPU ready ~35-39%) since about 18:20, and the slow HTTP on web-03 and web-04 is most likely VMs starved of CPU there. hv-02 has no alert for this. That web-03 and web-04 run on hv-02 is an assumption: no tags or groups record it.

ruled_out: web-03 and web-04 guest resources: CPU 24% and 21%, memory 56% and 58%, disk 40%, ICMP loss 0
Load balancer lb-01: 4 of 4 backends healthy, 5xx 0.06%, CPU 24%
web-01 and web-02: http.resp.ms about 430-470, normal
Network loss to web-03 and web-04: icmp loss 0 and ping OK

evidence.claim: Only web-03 and web-04 have open problems (Slow HTTP response, opened 18:21:24 and 18:21:33)
web-03 http.resp.ms went from about 390-510 ms to 2993 ms at 18:21 and was 3045 ms at 18:25 (sampled every 60s)
web-04 http.resp.ms went from 399 ms at 18:19:33 to 2982 ms at 18:20:33 and stayed 3000-3500 ms. Its CPU is 20.7%, so the slowdown is not load on the guest
web-01 http.resp.ms is 429 ms and web-02 is 468 ms, so those two are not affected
hv-02 hv.cpu.ready.pct went from 1.87 at 18:17:35 to 38.69 at 18:20:35 and stayed at 35.18 at 18:23:35. This is the same minute the web slowdown began
hv-02 hv.cpu.util.pct went from 39% at 18:17:14 to 98.3% at 18:20:14 and was 98.8% at 18:23:14
hv-01 hv.cpu.ready.pct is 1.09 and CPU 40%, which is healthy
hv-02 has only ICMP loss and ping triggers, so its CPU saturation cannot alert
web-04 shows CPU 20.7%, memory 57.5%, ICMP loss 0 and 5xx 0.39% while its response time is 3080 ms

next_step: Check which VMs are on hv-02 and confirm web-03 and web-04 are among them, then find what started consuming CPU on hv-02 around 18:20 (a noisy neighbour VM, a backup or a migration) and move or throttle it.
note: Run through the Claude Code harness with prompts/investigator/v1.md and tools/zq.mjs; not the product loop.
